newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES - AUG 30-SEPT 1.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES - AUG 30-SEPT 1.

text.p: English and Scottish league soccer

English division three - Swansea v Lincoln.
